Description

Keep breakouts at bay and achieve a clear, smooth complexion with this iconic daily exfoliating pad. Formulated with a base of Salix Alba (Willow) Bark Water and Betaine Salicylate (BHA), it gently but effectively dissolves excess sebum, dead skin cells, and impurities that clog pores. Infused with Tea Tree Leaf Oil and Madecassoside, it helps calm active breakouts, soothe redness, and balance the skin's natural oil production. Enriched with Panthenol and a multi-hyaluronic acid complex, these pads ensure your skin stays deeply hydrated and comfortable without feeling tight or stripped. Perfect for oily, acne-prone, and textured skin.

 

How to use 

After cleansing your face, gently wipe the embossed side of the pad across your skin to exfoliate and remove impurities, avoiding the delicate eye area.
